subject: Business Models
title: Platform Switching Moments
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Platform Switching Moments.

hook.text: People rarely switch platforms voluntarily. It takes a crisis to break the loyalty loop.

buildup.text: Major platform switches happen during technology shifts: mobile killed desktop platforms, cloud killed on-premise.

discovery.text: iPhone's launch was a switching moment. Nokia and BlackBerry had loyal users—until a better paradigm arrived.

twist.text: AI may be the next switching moment. ChatGPT reached 100 million users in 2 months—faster than any platform.

climax.text: Switching moments are rare but decisive. Incumbents fall and new giants rise in technology transitions.

punchline.text: Loyalty is strong until a paradigm shifts. Then everything changes.

quiz.question: What typically triggers a major platform switch?
